result.description:
Senior Project Engineer   Location:  Sydney, Brisbane OR Melbourne Office locations 
  Work on exciting utility-scale renewable energy projects from conception through to commissioning/handover with one of Australia's leading energy players.   I am partnering with a client with a very strong project pipeline across HV infrastructure, renewable energy projects, and more. They have a strong brand name with proven excellence in delivering projects. With a long-standing history in the Australian market and strong industry relationships, they are a go to for their clients and partners.     About The Role:   Working with the Project Delivery team, the Senior Project Engineer will help deliver end-to-end HV infrastructure and utility-scale renewable energy projects. This is an exciting role for a candidate who wants to join a highly qualified and capable project delivery team with a strong brand and name in the market across their project partners. This client truly values their employees, client and delivery partner relationships, and has a great culture & office environment celebrating wins, projects, career growth & promoting their employees internally and more.   
 Key Responsibilities: 
 
 Lead and manage electrical engineering activities across the project lifecycle. 
 Oversee design reviews, installation, commissioning, and compliance with industry standards. 
 Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure project milestones are achieved. 
 Drive safety, quality, and environmental outcomes in line with company standards 
 Provide technical expertise and mentor junior engineers. 
 
  Your Experience: 
 
 Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering 
 7+ years experience in electrical engineering, project engineering, and HV project delivery 
 Registered with Engineers Australia 
 Experience on large scale complex infrastructure and renewable energy projects 
 Site and project engineering experience with NSPs, coordination, multiple stakeholders, and sub contractors 
 BESS project delivery experience (highly desirable) 
 
  What We're Looking For:  
 
  Qualifications:  Bachelor of Engineering (Electrical). 
  Skills:  Strong problem-solving, teamwork, and communication abilities. 
  Experience:  Large Scale Infrastructure and Renewable Energy Projects 
  Attributes:  Accountability, initiative, and a results-driven mindset. 
  Essential:  Driver's licence and willingness to travel to site & interstate as required. 
 
  Whats On Offer?  
 
 Work in a collaborative environment that values innovation and excellence. 
 Contribute to projects that exceed industry standards and client expectations. 
 Access opportunities for professional growth and development. 
 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.
